verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade into her level 3-5 Q-W-E all-in while she still has full Runic Blade charges; you win if you play the wait-out game and punish her after Valor (E) and Ki Burst (W) are spent.

brief.thesis: Riven's power is front-loaded into a short-cooldown burst combo — three Q (Broken Wings) charges, a Ki Burst (W) stun on an 11-7s cooldown, and Valor (E) as a damage-blocking dash — that peaks hardest in the early levels. Fiora's kit rewards patience instead: Duelist stacks reward sustained trades, and Riposte (W) directly punishes the basic attacks her Runic Blade passive is built around. The head-to-head sits at 51.7% over 286 games with Fiora holding lane advantage but an even solo-kill rate, so this is a close, skill-driven lane, not a free one.

theirWindow.what: She has all three Q charges, Ki Burst (W) off cooldown, and Valor (E) to engage or disengage. This is her strongest all-in window — don't extend trades here, and hold Riposte (W) rather than burning it on a poke auto.

yourWindow.when: Right after her W or E is spent
yourWindow.what: Ki Burst (11-7s) and Valor (10-6s) are both short but real windows — once either is down she has no stun and no damage-block dash. Go in, stack your Duelist passive with repeated hits, and use Riposte's parry to punish her next auto for the AD bonus and reflected damage.

start.why: 91.9% pick rate and the highest winrate start (49.1% over 316 games) — the extra sustain from lifesteal plus Duelist stacking lets you match her Runic Blade trades without losing the HP war.

boots.why: 84.8% pick, 48.3% winrate — Riven's damage is entirely physical and auto-reliant through Runic Blade charges, so flat AA damage reduction blunts her combo harder than magic resist ever would here.

core.why: Highest-winrate path (61.9% over 63 games) — sustain and waveclear let you match her split-push threat while healing through poke.

runes.keystoneWhy: Data favors it here (50% winrate at 10.3% pick vs Conqueror's 30% at 9.1%) — the isolated-target burst rewards you for landing three hits in her short damage-block window before Valor (E) comes back up.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 75.9% and the highest winrate combo (50.2%) — with the matchup this close (51.7% over 286 games), Ignite is what converts an even trade into a kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Hold Riposte through her all-in window
playing.detail: Between levels 3 and 5 she has all three Q (Broken Wings) charges plus Ki Burst (W) and Valor (E) up. Don't burn Riposte on a poke auto — save it to parry the auto she lands after her combo.

playing.title: Track Runic Blade charge stacks
playing.detail: Her passive charges off her abilities and her autos spend those charges for bonus damage. If she's thrown out Q or W recently, her next auto hits harder — that's the one to parry.

playing.title: Extend fights after her E is spent
playing.detail: Valor (E) only blocks incoming damage briefly and is on a 10-6s cooldown. Once it's used, stay in the trade — Duelist stacks reward you for staying in extended fights, and her block window is gone.

playing.title: Punish the gap after Q3 knockback
playing.detail: Her full Q (Broken Wings) combo, including the knockback on the third hit, puts Broken Wings on a 13s cooldown with nothing left to reposition with. Use Lunge (Q) to close back in immediately.

playing.title: Rush Ravenous Hydra before forcing extended trades
playing.detail: The sustain and waveclear from your first item lets you match her split-push pattern and win prolonged skirmishes rather than short trades.

playing.title: Save Blade Waltz for skirmishes, not just picks
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (R) is best used once her Valor (E) is already spent defensively — she has no damage block left to survive the dash sequence.

playing.title: Don't get greedy on even trades
playing.detail: The head-to-head sits at 51.7% over 286 games — this isn't a lane where you can facetank speculative all-ins. Use Ignite to convert clean windows into kills instead of trading blind.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the timing windows, cooldown reads, and trade patterns are my own tactical judgement layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks while fighting her. Block any of her skills with [W] to prevent her dishing out her full combo and therefore giving you the upper hand.
